verdicts.reason: A keeps the bottle big and the NEW badge sits sensibly above the headline, but the cream circle has come away from the bottle and is cut off at the bottom-left, and the Try It button floats above the headline's baseline without sharing an axis with it. B shrinks the bottle to a tiny graphic, leaves the cream circle as an empty blob in the lower-left, puts the headline at the top with the lower half dead, and scatters NEW and Try It on a different line from the headline, so the layout reads as fragmented and unbalanced.
